notes: A new map! It unlocks after surviving 15 minutes in The Neon Perdition
Gourdmas Hollow: a crooked spiral hill where autumn nightmares and midwinter cheer got tangled together. Grinning lanterns, candy stripes, snow on pumpkins
Its own monsters (Lanternlings, Stitchlings, Gingerbones, Gift Mimics, Sleigh Hearses and more), a mini-boss, 5 bosses, music and village (Wreathwick Square)
A tonal nod to a certain spooky holiday movie; everything is original to this game
